subject: ADVI crashes on me when I use normal_(c)cdf

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: ADVI crashes on me when I use normal_(c)cdf
parts:
Hi!

I wanted to throw ADVI on a model which has censored data and had terms as increment_log_prob(normal_cdf_log(0, mu, 1)) in my model, but this makes advi core dump on me. Here is a complete minimal example to make ADVI produce a core dump:

parameters {
  real<lower=-100,upper=100> mu;
}
model {
  increment_log_prob(normal_cdf_log(0, mu, 1));
}

Anything I am missing conceptually here?

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ADVI crashes on me when I use normal_(c)cdf
parts:
The problem's internal --- we're not (yet) catching exceptions, which
is why ADVI isn't in R yet (Ben realized what was going on before we
started crashing users' R sessions.)

- Bob
